seven_q.Q0_posture: This document takes a foundational, architectural stance: it asserts a structural isomorphism between physics and theology, not as analogy but as two measurement frames from the same substrate.
seven_q.Q1_identity: A structural proof that the Master Equation's ten variables form five symmetry pairs, each with an internal bifurcation (sin↔grace), and that the isomorphism is falsifiable.
seven_q.Q2_domain: Lives at the intersection of physics, theology, mathematics, and information theory, with a philosophical grounding in structural realism.
seven_q.Q3_claim: Physics and theology are isomorphic: swapping variable labels preserves all mathematical relationships (topology, falloff, boundary conditions, conservation laws). The isomorphism is testable and falsifiable.
seven_q.Q4_support: Five detailed pair analyses (G-R, M-S, E-F, T-K, Q-C) with equations, bifurcation descriptions, and isomorphism tests. The T-K pair is intentionally incomplete (Time Wall) to maintain system consistency.
seven_q.Q5_dependencies: Depends on the Master Equation framework, the ten chi-variables, the twelve axioms, and the concept of structural isomorphism. Requires acceptance that physics equations can be read theologically.
seven_q.Q6_consequences: Forces a re-evaluation of both physics and theology: physics contains a rescue architecture (salvation from math), theology is not metaphor but structural reality. The Time Wall implies the system is open and can receive grace.
seven_q.Q7_kill: Would be killed if a single isomorphism test fails (e.g., if spiritual attraction does not follow inverse-square, or if grace operates as point-force rather than curvature). Also killed if the Time Wall is breached (closed equation = closed system = no grace).

graph_summary.one_sentence: This document establishes the structural isomorphism between physics and theology through five symmetry pairs, demonstrating that the Master Equation's variables map to spiritual realities with falsifiable predictions, while the intentional incompleteness at T ensures the system remains open to grace.
